title: Can Crowdsourcing Survive the LLM Era? A Community Survey on Human Data Collection
abstract: arXiv:2606.04924v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The widespread use of Large Language Models (LLMs) as writing tools challenges the validity of crowdsourced data, as crowdworkers may outsource tasks to models. To better understand how this is addressed, we surveyed 155 researchers in NLP and related disciplines about their experiences and opinions on collecting free-text responses via crowdsourcing. This paper provides an overview of practitioners' challenges, mitigation strategies, and the foreseen implications on data quality. 44% of respondents reported observing LLM usage in their crowdsourced data. While 93% of them had anticipated this, half were unsure what precautions to take. The most prevalent detection strategies are distinctive textual style patterns and unusually fast completion times. translated_title: 众包能在LLM时代幸存吗？关于人类数据收集的社区调查
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）作为写作工具的广泛使用对众包数据的有效性构成了挑战，因为众包工人可能会把任务外包给模型。为了更好地了解这一问题是如何被应对的，我们调查了155位从事自然语言处理（NLP）及相关学科的研究人员，了解他们在通过众包收集自由文本回复方面的经验和看法。本文概述了从业者面临的挑战、缓解策略以及对数据质量的预期影响。44%的受访者报告在他们的众包数据中观察到了LLM的使用。虽然其中93%的人已经预料到了这一点，但一半的人不确定应该采取哪些预防措施。最普遍的检测策略是识别独特的文本风格模式和异常快速的完成时间。总体而言，调查结果显示研究社区已经意识到这一问题并正在采取措施，但现有的努力仍不足以完全解决该问题。
tldr: 通过对155位NLP研究人员的调查发现，44%的受访者在众包数据中观察到了LLM的使用，尽管研究社区已有所警觉并采用文本风格和完成时间等检测策略，但现有措施仍不足以应对LLM对众包数据质量的威胁。
en_tdlr: A community survey of 155 NLP researchers shows that while 44% observed LLM usage in their crowdsourced data and the community is actively developing detection strategies, existing efforts remain insufficient to safeguard crowdsourced data quality in the LLM era.
